text: Work that runs past one job. Each step is done in its own act, and a step still undone when its act ends is gone for good.

quests.name: The miner's debt
quests.blurb: Con-Reg holds the paper on eleven years of your boots. Lose the paper, and the Company has to find you the hard way.

steps.next: Rook's job, on the board: lose your file from Depot 4's terminal.
steps.said: Your file is gone from Depot 4. Con-Reg will find the paper again, but not this month.

steps.next: Con-Reg's courier, with your paper filed again: marked on the chart.

place.name: Con-Reg claims tender
place.text: A Con-Reg claims tender at the system's edge, logging the colony for the Company's lawyers. Recovery crews her.

steps.next: Con-Reg's claims tender, within reach of the colony: Recovery holds her.

payoff.said: The tender's log had the colony in it. It doesn't now: Con-Reg has to find you the hard way, and its raids come half as often.

quests.name: The deserter's pardon
quests.blurb: The Provost has a warrant with your name on it. Lose the warrant, square it with your old ship, and the Provost has nothing to go on.

steps.next: Mother Ilse's job, on the board: lose your warrant in the Provost's filing.
steps.said: Your warrant is in the wrong drawer under the wrong name. The Provost will find it, eventually.

steps.next: The Resolute, your old tender, short of spares: marked on the chart.

place.name: Provost courier
place.text: A Provost courier cutter at the system's edge, your file in her safe and the colony's bearing in her log.

steps.next: The Provost's courier, within reach of the colony: her MPs hold her.

payoff.said: Your file and the courier's log go into the colony's furnace. The Provost starts over from nothing, and its raids come half as often.

quests.name: The smuggler's cargo
quests.blurb: Forty crates of the Hallorans' went out your airlock. Bring them back, crate by crate, and square it with the family.

steps.next: Ferris's job, on the board: eleven of the crates, out of the customs pound.
steps.said: Eleven crates back in Halloran hands. Old Halloran sends word that it's a start.

steps.next: The other twenty-nine crates, adrift where you dumped them: marked on the chart.

place.name: Halloran runner
place.text: A Halloran runner at the family's drop, her collectors come for the interest on forty crates.

steps.next: The Hallorans' runner at their drop, within reach of the colony: their collectors hold her.

payoff.said: The collectors fly home in their lifeboat with word for Old Halloran: paid in full. He'll take it, this once, and the family's raids come half as often.

quests.name: The tender's stores
quests.blurb: Pirates took the Fleet tender's stores pod. Bring it home, and the Fleet remembers who did.

steps.next: The tender's stolen stores pod: marked on the chart, from the next sector on.
